name: An Adultress
overview: Scripture clearly condemns adultery as a serious sin against God's law, beginning with the direct command not to commit adultery (Exodus 20:14) and the severe penalty prescribed in the Old Testament (Leviticus 20:10). The New Testament reiterates this command and expands on its spiritual implications, warning that putting away a spouse and marrying another constitutes adultery (Matthew 19:9; Luke 16:18). Proverbs highlights the destructive nature of adultery, emphasizing that it reflects a lack of understanding and leads to the ruin of one's soul (Proverbs 6:32). These passages collectively underscore the holiness of marriage and the grave consequences of violating this covenant.
